newsitem.title: bangladesh: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said on Saturday the country's macro-economic situation "is sound, stable and looking up".
Prime MInister Sheikh Hasina dicussed bilateral issues on Saturday with her Indian counterpart H D Deve Gowda in New Delhi.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday declared the commitment of her government and the party to remedy the imbalance between men and women towards participation in politics.
Area commander level border talks between Bangladesh and Burma will be held in Cox's Bazar on Monday.
President Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed on Saturday urged all political parties to place the country's interest above party politics.
Former Prime Minister and the opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Saturday accused the government of violating the constitution.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed has asked the managements of the state owned industries to boost production and efficiency to survive in the competitive market.
A high-level meeting in Dhaka on Saturday discussed alternative ways to privatise state-owned jute and textile mills.
